content: 2.1.1 Tuen Ma Extension is a railway scheme to improve railway accessibility to Tuen Mun South area. The new extension will serve the community south of Tuen Mun town centre and the new development area of A16. The A16 station is located on the Tuen Mun River waterfront promenade serving the existing catchments on the west bank of the river (i.e. Lung Mun Oasis, Glorious Garden) and east of Hoi Wong Road (i.e. Nerine Cove, Oceania Heights) as well as the future population in the development area of A16.

B. Waste Water Disposal System
1. Discharge Flow
i. Normal Discharge Flow to Floor Drain/ Channel 0.3 l/sec (1 no. cleansing point)
ii. Fire Discharge Flow to Floor Drain/ Channel
(Applicable to A16 Station and Trackside)		 22.5 l/sec (3 no. fire hydrants)
iii. Concession Sink (Discharge Units (DU) as per Table 5, Pg 112 in PESD Guide, published by IOP) 1.3 DU (l/sec)
2. Sizing of Waste Water Sump Pit
i. Effective Volume To cater for the normal inflows but not less 5 minutes of fire hydrant test flow and 1hr. of seepage rate

i.e. Effective volume (m3) = {5 min. x 22.5l/sec} + {1hr. of seepage flow} (if the sump pit also for collection of trackside seepage water) = 6.75m3 + Seepage flow;

However, it shall be sufficient for pump continuous operation not less than 5minutes and not more than 4 on/ off cycles per hour
ii. Emergency Storage To cater for the emergency inflows:

i.e. Emergency storage (m3) = assumed 4 hrs of half cleansing water flow due to failure/not closed (0.15l/sec) (i.e. tunnel sump/Station cleansing point) + 4 hrs trackside washdown (i.e. the washing water flow for the longest served tunnel at 25m3/km/ hr but not more than 25m3) * 4 hrs seepage

* Since the water tank for tunnel washing is not more than 25m3, the water consumption for each time of tunnel washing is assumed not exceeding 25m3.
iii. Diversity Where a waste water sump pit has been designed for collecting both Station and trackside waste water in the event of a "SINGLE FIRE" and "SINGLE TRACK WASHDOWN" occurring simultaneously has been considered. Therefore, the max. flow from operation of 3 no. fire hydrants plus washdown in the longest tunnel will be considered in the calculations.
